574-5170-6132-8292.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Massacre Girl triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Massacre Girl trigger.
Resolve the Massacre Girl trigger, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat.
574-5170-6132-8292.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

1770-2226-6844.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
1770-2226-6844.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Elesh Norn.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Spider-Man 2099 by paying its mana cost.
When Spider-Man 2099 enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

2403-4279-6887--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2403-4279-6887--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake, The Skullspore Nexus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus ability, creating a X/X Fungus creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2390-5876-6191.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2390-5876-6191.description:
Gain life.
Elenda's Hierophant triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1174-1671-2092-3869.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least one mana.
1174-1671-2092-3869.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has at least X power.
1174-1671-2092-3869.description:
Activate another land that enters untapped by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {1} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron and returning the land tapped in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Gretchen by paying {G}{U} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron, causing you to draw a card and put the land returned to hand in step 2 onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

2586-3197-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Odric's Outrider triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat

1479-2443-2692-2841.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Evolving Wilds.
1479-2443-2692-2841.description:
Fetch a land using Evolving Wilds.
When the fetched land enters, Felidar Retreat and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Felidar Retreat triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

728-2724-3217-3582.description:
Activate Kaya the Inexorable's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting a ghostform counter on Wormfang Manta.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability and its ghostform ability trigger.
Resolve the ghostform trigger, returning Wormfang Manta from your graveyard to your hand and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
Repeat each turn.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

2292-3197-6566--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Yuna triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 5.

1580-3220-4871-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

129-1115-1409-6006.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

2-3821-6751.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{U}.
2-3821-6751.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, untapping five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying its mana cost.
When Ancestral Statue enters, it triggers twice, returning it and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1497-5660-5684.description:
Cast Wild Cantor by paying its mana cost.
When Wild Cantor enters, Metastatic Evangel triggers.
Holding priority, activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it, adding {R/G}
Resolve the Metastatic Evangel trigger, causing you to proliferate and put a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Wild Cantor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

891-1052-2511.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Repeat.

4605-4681-6797-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {5}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Karmic Guide and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Karmic Guide token enters, it triggers, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1563-2457-4772-6791.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

394-3240-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nether Traitor, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {B}.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

997-2281-5925.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Jackdaw Savior.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Jackdaw Savior.
When Jackdaw Savior dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Jackdaw Savior trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Jackdaw Savior from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

803-1429-2438-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
803-1429-2438-5402.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1719-2628-6072-6185.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in hand.
You control a mana-producing permanent.
1719-2628-6072-6185.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands' cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it due to New Perspectives.
Escape Protocol and Vizier of Tumbling Sands trigger.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbing Sands trigger, untapping a mana-producing permanent.
Reoslve the Escape Protocol trigger, blinking Graveshifter.
When Graveshifter enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Vizier of Tumbing Sands from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the cycling ability from step 2, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

967-2438-5173-5258-5618.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Shambling Ghast from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, exiling Shambling Ghast from the top of your library with the ability to cast it until your next turn.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Shambling Ghast from exile by paying {1}.
Prosper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

813-3647-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Scholar of the Ages and up to one other creature you control.
Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, triggering itself, returning Walk the Aeons and Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

729-2068-4283.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
Whisper does not have summoning sickness.
729-2068-4283.description:
Activate Whisper by tapping it, sacrificing Great Oak Guardian and any other creature you control, targeting any other creature card in your graveyard.
Ashnod the Uncaring triggers, copying Whisper's ability, targeting Great Oak Guardian.
Resolve the copy of Whisper's ability, returning Great Oak Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Great Oak Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the original Whisper ability, returning the targeted creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-2896-5145.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars, adding {C}{C}.
When Archon of Falling Stars dies, it triggers, returning Necromancy from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Necromancy enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Necromancy to it.
Repeat.

957-2660-2707.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U}, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Time Stretch is put on the bottom of your library instead of into your graveyard due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Move to your first extra turn, drawing Time Stretch from the bottom of your library during your draw step due to River Song.
Move to your second extra turn.
Repeat.

3493-3499-4289.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
3493-3499-4289.description:
Activate Patrol Signaler and another creature you control by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Activate Patrol Signaler by paying {1}{W} and untapping it, creating a 1/1 Kithkin Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

2034-2209-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ancient Stone Idol, adding {C}{C}.
When Ancient Stone Idol dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger,
Resolve the Ancient Stone Idol trigger, creating a creature token.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Ancient Stone Idol from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

228-678-1069-1778.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
228-678-1069-1778.description:
Activate Skullclamp's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Memnite.
Memnite dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness, triggering Enduring Renewal and Skullclamp.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Memnite from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Skullclamp trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Repeat.

888-1173-2704-5261.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{R} on your first turn, with {2} available on each extra turn
888-1173-2704-5261.description:
Cast Isochron Scepter by paying {2}.
Isochron Scepter enters the battlefield, triggering its imprint ability.
Holding priority, activate Tawnos by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, copying Isochron Scepter's trigger.
Resolve both Isochron Scepter triggers, exiling Tale's End and Final Fortune from your hand.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Final Fortune without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Final Fortune, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of the end step during your extra turn, Final Fortune triggers.
Holding prioirty, activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Tale's End and Final Fortune without paying their mana cost.
Resolve Tale's End, countering Final Fortune's trigger from step 8.
Repeat from step 6.

1493-4944.description:
Activate Urza's Avenger's ability.
Hold priority and repeat this an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve the Crackdown Construct triggers, making Crackdown Construct arbitrarily large.

1309-1987-2427-3941.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Coveted Jewel and Salvager of Secrets, blinking them.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Coveted Jewel enters the battlefield, draw three cards.
Repeat.
